This setup is supported by the volume profile, which shows declining volume on the retracement, indicating a lack of buying pressure to sustain the upward move.

Confluence 5: Standard Deviation (SD) Bands, Malaysian SNR, and Candlestick Patterns with Volatility Indicators. The 78100.00 entry level aligns with the +1 Standard Deviation band of the M15 price mean, representing an overextended short-term deviation.
